queries.query_text: human tumor microenvironment microbial metabolite quantification mass spectrometry ICI
Are there any studies reporting direct intratumoral quantification of microbial metabolites such as inosine or SCFAs in human solid tumors treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors?

still_missing: This study does not report direct quantification of inosine or other metabolites within human tumor tissue (TME); measurements were restricted to plasma in humans and tumor tissue in mice. There is no comparison of human intratumoral metabolite concentrations versus fecal or plasma samples in ICI-treated patients. The specific methodology for human TME metabolite extraction and quantification remains unaddressed in this text.
usable_content: This study utilized Matrix-Assisted Laser Desorption/Ionization mass spectrometry imaging (MALDI-MSI) to perform in situ metabolite quantification in paired human non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) tumor and normal tissue (n=15). The authors reported significantly higher levels of UMP, AMP, and ADP in tumor tissue compared to normal tissue, while metabolites downstream of adenosine, specifically adenine and inosine, showed no significant differences. This demonstrates the technical feasibility of directly quantifying specific metabolites, including inosine, within the human tumor microenvironment using mass spectrometry, which aligns with the methodological aspect of the gap question.
